body:
The 3D plan follows Karolis' drawn lines (Map → Area plan, 10 slides with keep/redo and a comment each).
Changes 30 Oct:
- No trees inside the farm or the jump field; trees only around them.
- Roads and the horse trail are smooth and join each other cleanly, with round ends; the gate junction was redone.
- The horse trail no longer touches the lake.
- Nothing big stands on roads or trails.
Left to do: mountains plain, labrador body plain, a faint green line on the lawn.

comments.text: Pictures renewed with the real game town (30 Oct). Red rings = game forest trees on the new trail and roads.
Karolis in the Map chat, 31 Oct: 'all looks good in map'. He placed the farm himself in the Area plan; that saved scene is the plan.

title: Farm, horse trail and jump field: 3D area plan
